en.title: Rusted Skies and Memories of Rain
en.premise: As a scrap collector, all I ever found was junk—until I picked up a lost AI with a mind of its own. It is a remnant of the god that once ruled this city, a forbidden technology so coveted that the pursuing Steam Knights will stop at nothing to claim it. On the run, I eventually find my way to the "Antique Shop that Opens Only on Rainy Days." There, I am forced to face the fatal flaw within this city and the truth hidden deep inside the AI.

zh.title: 锈色天空与雨之记忆
zh.premise: 身为废料回收商的我，偶然捡到了一个拥有自我意识的迷路人工智能（AI）。它曾是统治这座城市的“神”之残骸，也是令追捕者的蒸汽骑士团垂涎欲滴的禁忌技术。在漫长的逃亡之后，我来到了那家“仅在雨天开门的古董店”。在那里，我揭开了这座城市所隐藏的致命缺陷，以及那个AI背后所掩盖的真相。
